name: Drawer
description: A modal side sheet that springs in from any edge of the viewport over a blurred backdrop, with a title, description, scrollable body and footer actions. Focus is trapped while open and restored to the trigger on close.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA modal dialog pattern: role="dialog" with aria-modal, aria-labelledby (title) and aria-describedby (description). The trigger exposes aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded. Focus moves to the first control on open, Tab/Shift+Tab cycle inside the panel, Escape and backdrop click close it, and focus returns to the trigger. Body scroll is locked while open. The default settings use native checkboxes with role="switch" and associated labels. Under prefers-reduced-motion the panel only fades.

defaultProps.title: Notifications
defaultProps.description: Choose what you want to hear about. Changes apply to all your devices.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Viewport edge the drawer slides in from.

propsApi.name: size

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Drawer title, used as the accessible name.

propsApi.name: description
propsApi.default: 'Choose what you want to hear about. Changes apply to all your devices.'
propsApi.description: Supporting text under the title, used as the accessible description.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Body content; defaults to a list of notification switches.

propsApi.name: onConfirm
propsApi.description: Called when the primary action is pressed; the drawer then closes.

propsApi.name: closeOnOutsideClick

propsApi.name: showCloseButton
